## 6. Opponent-intent labels (band = the LABELLED human's rating)

Every turn decision of the viewer gets the opponent's action that turn as its label. CHOICE = the opponent's observable turn choice; PROD = the production label rules approximated on the text (a window closing on the viewer's forced switch, a phaze / faint / Baton Pass co-occurring with a switch, or an Encore override all MASK). `_rev` = the move / switch-in was already revealed before the decision (alpha's seat / beta's slot exists deterministically); `_new` = first reveal (the belief must have put it in its top-K seats, unmeasured here); `MOVE_hp` = Hidden Power (the replay never states its type).
